name: io.github.WYRE-AI/cisco-duo-mcp
title: Cisco Duo
description: MCP server for Cisco Duo's identity/MFA administration API.

environmentVariables.name: DUO_IKEY
environmentVariables.description: Duo integration key (Basic-auth username for the v5 signed-request scheme). Not secret on its own, but paired with DUO_SKEY it authenticates as this integration.

environmentVariables.name: DUO_SKEY
environmentVariables.description: Duo secret key - HMAC-SHA512 signing key for every request. Bearer-equivalent for this integration's admin scope.

environmentVariables.name: DUO_API_HOST
environmentVariables.description: This account's Duo API hostname, e.g. api-xxxxxxxx.duosecurity.com.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_TRANSPORT
environmentVariables.description: Transport mode for the server. Set to 'stdio' for local CLI use; the image defaults to 'http' for gateway hosting.

environmentVariables.name: AUTH_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Credential source: 'env' reads vars locally, 'gateway' expects header injection from the WYRE MCP Gateway.

environmentVariables.name: LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Log verbosity: debug, info, warn, error
